remarks: 2 BR, 1.5 bath tri-level townhouse with attached garage in a desirable complex with in-ground pool and lush landscape. The open staircase welcomes you to the sunny main level that offers living/ dining room, updated kitchen and sliders to the deck. Wide plank flooring, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, recess lightings, build-in speakers are few of the upgrades. Upstairs offers two bedrooms with bamboo flooring and a full bath. Finished LL w/tile floor has laundry, accees to attached garage and a huge room that could be used as third bedroom/office/family room. Besides the attached garage unit comes with one reserved spot(#40) and one spot in front of the garage. Pet friendly complex with ample of visitor's parking. Close to I-95, restuarants and shopping.
